competencyItem: Laboratory and biochemical analysis of nutritional status
diagnosis: Severe protein-calorie malnutrition in a preoperative surgical patient.
notes: Laboratory nutritional work-up shows a low serum albumin and reduced total lymphocyte count, confirming significant malnutrition before surgery.
description: Preoperative nutritional assessment by laboratory and biochemical analysis.

competencyItem: Laboratory and biochemical analysis of nutritional status
diagnosis: Postoperative nutritional depletion after major gastrointestinal resection.
notes: Serial biochemical monitoring shows a low serum albumin and transferrin, consistent with ongoing postoperative catabolism.
description: Postoperative nutritional monitoring after major GI resection.

competencyItem: Laboratory and biochemical analysis of nutritional status
diagnosis: Hypoalbuminemia in a patient awaiting major elective surgery.
notes: Biochemical analysis confirms marked hypoalbuminemia with a low prealbumin, indicating the need for nutritional optimisation before surgery.
description: Biochemical nutritional assessment before major surgery.

competencyItem: Laboratory and biochemical analysis of nutritional status
diagnosis: Nutritional depletion secondary to a high-output enterocutaneous fistula.
notes: Laboratory analysis shows hypoalbuminemia, electrolyte derangement, and trace element deficiency consistent with fistula-related nutritional losses.
description: Nutritional assessment in a patient with a high-output enterocutaneous fistula.

competencyItem: Laboratory and biochemical analysis of nutritional status
diagnosis: Preoperative nutritional risk assessment before elective major surgery.
notes: Biochemical nutritional screening shows a borderline low serum albumin, prompting preoperative nutritional optimisation.
description: Preoperative nutritional optimisation assessment before elective major surgery.

diagnosis: Postoperative ileus following major abdominal surgery.
notes: Nasogastric feeding tube placed and a graded enteral feeding regimen instituted under supervision.

diagnosis: Inability to swallow after upper gastrointestinal surgery.
notes: Nasojejunal feeding tube passed endoscopically and enteral feeding commenced to bypass the upper GI anastomosis.
description: Nasojejunal feeding after upper GI surgery.

diagnosis: Prolonged postoperative ileus after major abdominal surgery.
notes: Nasogastric tube feeding administered with a graded enteral feeding regimen to support nutrition during prolonged postoperative ileus.
description: Enteral nutrition support for prolonged postoperative ileus.

diagnosis: Long-term enteral feeding need after major oesophageal cancer surgery.
notes: Feeding jejunostomy constructed at the time of oesophagectomy to secure long-term enteral access.
description: Feeding jejunostomy construction for long-term enteral nutrition.

diagnosis: Long-term enteral nutrition need in a surgical patient with dysphagia following head and neck cancer surgery.
notes: Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy tube inserted under endoscopic guidance for long-term enteral feeding access.
description: PEG tube insertion for long-term enteral nutrition.

competencyItem: Venous cannulation for central and peripheral parenteral feeding
diagnosis: Short bowel syndrome after extensive bowel resection requiring parenteral nutrition.
notes: Central venous cannulation performed under ultrasound guidance to establish access for total parenteral nutrition.
description: Central venous cannulation for parenteral nutrition in short bowel syndrome.
